units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> <he>נקובת הו׳</he> an animal whose gullet is found to have been perforated.—
<cite ref="Niddah 23b:44">Nidd. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>וֶשְׁטוֹ נקוב</he> if the infant’s gullet is perforated (there being a hole in the throat); <he>ו׳ אטום</he> if its gullet is closed; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 687">Yalk. Ps. 687</cite> (translating <he>מלקוחי</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 22:16">Ps. XXII, 16</cite>) <he>לוִושְׁטִי</he>; Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c. <he>לויסיטי</he> (corr. acc.; cmp. Lat. fauces) to my throat.
Ber. 8ᵃ (Rashi: loop-hole for the rope), v. פִּיטוּרִין a. צִיפּוּרִין; M. Kat. end; Lev. R. s. 4; Tanḥ. Mikk. 10; ed. Bub. 15; Koh. R. to VI, 6.
